scopeQualifications: 16 source pages read in this batch; no claim of cumulative unique-page coverage or full book atomization.

Lesson043 draws on paper/letter sizes and drawing roles; drawing-control consultation is a conservative original workplace application,not a claim that the cited pages establish a complete document-control system.
Third-angle placement is taught only after checking projection indication. No claim that every incoming international drawing follows this method.
Not every unhatched part is empty; source notes exceptions to sectioning. Exact drafting exceptions require applicable standard.
The normal mm convention is qualified by drawing unit specification; dimension number is not a paper measurement.
Reference dimensions are not silently converted to standalone acceptance requirements.

Geometric tolerance frame does not always need a datum; flatness is discussed as standalone shape,unnecessary datum is not added. Source table includes historical terminology; no standards-edition currency certification.
Welding arrow-side rule explicitly scoped to textbook notation; real work requires applicable standard/system confirmation.
Surface-parameter values in source examples are not universal recipes. Lesson049 is orientation to reading two distinct instruction families,not complete welding or roughness training.
30min is activity target,not measured learning time.
No SSW2 source consulted; native/domain review remains false.
